question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Tara thought that they were absurd on a dying saviour, that his sandals, his blazer, his hair, all were unsuited to the occassion.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"occassion"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"occasion"**. (अवसर)

 
 
• **Example: **We gathered to celebrate the special **occasion.**
 
 
 
• **"Occasion" **refers to a particular event or the time at which it takes place. (अवसर)
 
 
• **Example: **The wedding was a grand** occasion** for the family.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unsuited **(अनुपयुक्त): Not appropriate or fitting for a particular situation.

 
 
• **Example:** The formal attire was **unsuited** for the casual party.
 
 
 
• **Absurd **(बेतुका): Wildly unreasonable, illogical, or inappropriate.
 
 
• **Example: **His proposal was so** absurd **that everyone laughed.
 
 
 
• **Saviour** (उद्धारक): A person who saves someone or something from danger or difficulty.
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighter was hailed as a **saviour** for rescuing the trapped family.
